about: The graduale of the formulary “Nativity of the Lord — Mass during the Night” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: With Thee is dominion in the day of Thy power; in the splendors of holiness, from the womb before the day-star I begot Thee. The Lord said unto my Lord: Sit Thou at My right hand, until I make Thine enemies the footstool of Thy feet.
g: morning star, day star, planet Venus
